one_line: Nvidia faces leadership turmoil and export control scrutiny, while Anthropic draws heavy IPO demand and AWS builds code via agents.

themes.title: Nvidia leadership and export crisis
themes.text: Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang amid reports of personal misconduct and ties to an alleged Chinese spy, leading to a drop in stock price and rising pressure from U.S. lawmakers for export control legislation and hearings.

stories.headline: Nvidia stock drops as board reportedly prepares to oust CEO Jensen Huang
Nvidia board prepares to oust CEO Jensen Huang amid scandal
Jensen Huang affair raises chances of US chip export limits in NDAA
Senators ask Trump administration to preserve Nvidia-China records
House Republicans push for Nvidia's Jensen Huang to testify over spy allegations

themes.title: Export control evasion exposed
themes.text: Investigations reveal that Chinese entities and blacklisted universities bypassed U.S. export controls to acquire billions in Nvidia chips, prompting the U.S. Commerce Department to finalize rules blocking remote chip access.

stories.headline: Nvidia spy scandal exposes Singapore chip networks evading US export controls
Megaspeed founder Alice Huang returns to Beijing
PLA-linked Chinese university obtained Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist
Commerce Department finalizes rule to block remote AI chip access for China

themes.title: Industry developments and IPO activity
themes.text: Anthropic's IPO drew strong demand, AWS released an AI-generated local service emulator built without human code, and United Airlines blocked unauthorized third-party AI travel booking agents.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO draws multiple times the orders for available shares
AWS releases AWS Emulator built entirely by AI agents
United Airlines bars unauthorized AI agents from booking travel
